integrity.historical_holdout_status: CONSUMED; no date in historical storage may be presented as fresh validation
integrity.prospective_confirmation: A separate forward experiment may begin only after this specification is frozen; do not alter Paper Tracks 1-3.

core_hypothesis: IBS reversal is stronger when the signal-day move resembles temporary liquidity or technical pressure and weaker or reversed when it resembles information-driven repricing.

signal.cross_section: rank once across the full eligible universe; Q1 is the most favorable 20% and Q5 the least favorable 20%
signal.primary_horizon: enter next session open and exit that session close
signal.secondary_horizon_diagnostics: The same next-session-open entry through session 2 and session 5 closes is reported for horizon decay only and does not affect classification.
signal.reason: The signal is not fully known until the close, so same-close execution is not assumed.

universe.source: Sharadar domestic common stocks including delisted issues
universe.listing_policy: firstpricedate <= signal date <= lastpricedate where lastpricedate exists

conditioning_method: Test each variable independently. Continuous variables are assigned to daily cross-sectional terciles. IBS thresholds are formed globally before intersecting with a condition bucket, preserving a common definition of extreme IBS. No conditioning variables are combined in this program.

hypotheses.condition: signal-day volume / median volume over t-20..t-1
signal-day dollar volume / prior-day market capitalization

hypotheses.expected_sign: positive gross; net results after costs are mandatory implementation evidence

hypotheses.condition: 20-session volatility through t-1 of beta-adjusted daily residuals; beta estimated over prior 60 sessions
PIT lagged-cap-weighted internal market index relative to its 200-session moving average; bull above MA, bear below 95% of MA, sideways otherwise
hypotheses.contrast: bull minus bear; sideways reported separately

outcomes.primary: Daily gross Q1-minus-Q5 next-open-to-close IBS spread within each condition bucket; test the paired favorable-minus-adverse bucket spread with HAC(5) errors.
outcomes.implementation: Q1 long-only next-open-to-close return after ADV-tiered entry and exit costs.
required_metrics: SPY total-return CAGR over identical dates

cost_model.application: charged once at entry and once at exit for every long position

decision_rule.UNRESOLVED / UNDERPOWERED: fewer than 250 paired days, non-estimable result, or absolute t-stat below 2.81
decision_rule.qualification: All classifications describe historical development evidence, not independent validation. Prospective confirmation is required before promotion into a portfolio or modification of a frozen paper track.

known_limitations: Sharadar ARQ has filing/publication dates but no announcement timestamp, so before-open and after-close earnings cannot be separated.
Historical quoted spreads and order-book depth are unavailable; costs are estimated from ADV tiers.
Sharadar ticker history is not CRSP PERMNO continuity.
Historical borrowability and borrow fees are unavailable and are not assumed; the Q1-Q5 spread is a signal diagnostic, while the costed long leg is the implementable portfolio result.
